verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party SSO plugin supports OpenID Connect, OAuth2 providers and SAML 2.0, and the homepage markets SSO and SAML 2.0 as enterprise features. A community commenter independently notes SAML/SSO support but says some of those features are enterprise-only. missing for 10: no documented setup guides or examples for Okta, Entra or Google Workspace specifically, no detail on per-tenant IdP configuration or workforce sign-in flows, no hands-on corroboration of SAML in practice, and the enterprise-only tiering is unclear.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: This plugin supports OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0.
